children.name: Stachyurus chinensis Franch.
children.description: Stachyurus chinensis (中国旌节花), Chinese stachyurus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Stachyuraceae, native to China and Taiwan.

children.name: Stachyurus coaetaneus Chatterjee
children.description: The native range of this species is N. Myanmar. It is a tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Stachyurus cordatulus Merr.
children.description: The native range of this species is China (NW. Yunnan) to N. Myanmar. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Stachyurus himalaicus Hook.fil. & Thomson ex Benth.
children.description: The native range of this species is C. Himalaya to China (Yunnan) and N. Myanmar. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Stachyurus oblongifolius F.T.Wang & Tang
children.description: The native range of this species is China. It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Stachyurus obovatus  Hand.-Mazz.
children.description: The native range of this species is SC. China. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Stachyurus praecox Siebold & Zucc.
children.description: Stachyurus praecox, early stachyurus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Stachyuraceae, native to Japan.

children.name: Stachyurus retusus Y.C.Yang
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Sichuan, NE. Yunnan). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Stachyurus salicifolius Franch.
children.description: Stachyurus salicifolius, also known by the Chinese vernacular name 柳叶旌节花 (Liǔ yè jīng jié huā), is a species in the genus Stachyurus in the family Stachyuraceae.

children.name: Stachyurus yunnanensis Franch.
children.description: The native range of this species is S. China to N. Vietnam. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.
